cards.name: Lilligant
cards.description: The fragrance of the garland on its head has a relaxing effect. It withers if a Trainer does not take good care of it.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: It uses an up-tempo song and dance to drive away the bird Pokémon that prey on its flower seeds.

cards.name: Maractus
cards.description: Arid regions are their habitat. They move rhythmically, making a sound similar to maracas.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.description: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.description: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.

cards.name: Darumaka
cards.description: Darumaka's droppings are hot, so people used to put them in their clothes to keep themselves warm.

cards.description: When weakened in battle, it transforms into a stone statue, then it sharpens its mind and fights on mentally.

cards.name: Oshawott
cards.description: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Dewott
cards.description: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

cards.name: Samurott
cards.description: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.description: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.description: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Basculin
cards.description: Red and blue Basculin get along so poorly, they'll start fighting instantly. These Pokémon are very hostile.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food—peat moss.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.

cards.name: Alomomola
cards.description: Floating in the open sea is how they live. When they find a wounded Pokémon, they embrace it and bring it to shore.

cards.name: Alomomola

cards.name: Servine
cards.description: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

cards.name: Blitzle
cards.description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

cards.name: Zebstrika
cards.description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Joltik
cards.description: They attach themselves to large-bodied Pokémon and absorb static electricity, which they store in an electric pouch.

cards.name: Galvantula
cards.description: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.

cards.name: Zekrom
cards.description: This Pokémon appears in legends. In its tail, it has a giant generator that creates electricity.

cards.name: Munna
cards.description: Munna always float in the air. People whose dreams are eaten by them forget what the dreams had been about.

cards.name: Musharna
cards.description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: It emits sound waves of various frequencies from its nose, including some powerful enough to destroy rocks.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.description: Its bite injects a potent poison, enough to paralyze large bird Pokémon that try to prey on it.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.description: Highly aggressive, it uses the claws near its neck to dig into its opponent and poison them.

cards.name: Solosis
cards.description: Because their bodies are enveloped in a special liquid, they can survive in any environment.

cards.name: Duosion
cards.description: When their brains, now divided in two, are thinking the same thought, these Pokémon exhibit their maximum power.

cards.name: Reuniclus
cards.description: These remarkably intelligent Pokémon fight by controlling arms that can grip with rock-crushing power.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: It fights by swinging a piece of timber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle the lumber without difficulty.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: These Pokémon appear at building sites and help out with construction. They always carry squared logs.

cards.name: Serperior
cards.description: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.description: They strengthen their bodies by carrying steel beams. They show off their big muscles to their friends.

cards.name: Throh
cards.description: When they encounter foes bigger than themselves, they try to throw them. They always travel in packs of five.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.description: The sound of Sawk punching boulders and trees can be heard all the way from the mountains where they train.

cards.name: Sandile
cards.description: It moves along below the sand's surface, except for its nose and eyes. A dark membrane shields its eyes from the sun.

cards.name: Krokorok
cards.description: The special membrane covering its eyes can sense the heat of objects, so it can see its surroundings even in darkness.

cards.name: Krookodile
cards.description: It can expand the focus of its eyes, enabling it to see objects in the far distance as if it were using binoculars.

cards.name: Purrloin
cards.description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

cards.name: Liepard
cards.description: Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

cards.name: Scraggy
cards.description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

cards.name: Scrafty
cards.description: Groups of them beat up anything that enters their territory. Each can spit acidic liquid from its mouth.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Zorua
cards.description: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Zoroark
cards.description: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Vullaby
cards.description: Its wings are too tiny to allow it to fly. As the time approaches for it to evolve, it discards the bones it was wearing.

cards.name: Mandibuzz
cards.description: It makes a nest out of bones it finds. It grabs weakened prey in its talons and hauls it to its nest of bones.

cards.name: Klink
cards.description: The two minigears that mesh together are predetermined. Each will rebound from other minigears without meshing.

cards.name: Klang
cards.description: By changing the direction in which it rotates, it communicates its feelings to others. When angry, it rotates faster.

cards.name: Klinklang
cards.description: Its red core functions as an energy tank. It fires the charged energy through its spikes into an area.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watches for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.

cards.name: Patrat
cards.description: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

cards.name: Watchog
cards.description: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.description: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: It faces strong opponents with great courage. But, when at a disadvantage in a fight, this intelligent Pokémon flees.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.description: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Tranquill
cards.description: It can return to its Trainer's location regardless of the distance separating them.

cards.name: Unfezant
cards.description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.

cards.name: Audino
cards.description: It touches others with the feelers on its ears, using the sound of their heartbeats to tell how they are feeling.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.description: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Cinccino
cards.description: Their white fur is coated in a special oil that makes it easy for them to deflect attacks.

cards.name: Petilil
cards.description: Since they prefer moist, nutrient-rich soil, the areas where Petilil live are known to be good for growing plants.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
